archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) - Modified for Sober/Clean SaaS with Purple Accent

typography.section_label: text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400 font-bold mb-4
typography.table_header: text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 font-semibold pb-3

components_blueprint.AppShell: Flex layout with fixed left sidebar (w-64) and flex-1 main content area. Main area contains fixed TopBar and scrollable PageContainer.
components_blueprint.Sidebar: Fixed left, white bg, right border (border-slate-200). Top: Logo LIGO + 'Pro' badge (rounded-full bg-violet-100 text-violet-700). Tenant Card: Flex row, company logo (avatar) + Name + CNPJ, bg-slate-50 rounded-xl p-3 mx-4. Nav Groups: MT-6, 'NAVEGAÇÃO' label. Nav Items: Flex row, rounded-full pill shape. Default: text-slate-600, hover:bg-slate-50. Active: text-violet-700, bg-violet-50. Icon always violet-600.
components_blueprint.TopBar: Sticky top, white bg, border-b border-slate-200, px-8 py-4 flex justify-between items-center. Left: Breadcrumb (e.g., DASHBOARD / VISÃO GERAL) + Title (e.g., Visão Geral). Right: Actions toolbar with pill buttons (rounded-full). Primary: bg-violet-600 text-white. Secondary: bg-red-500 text-white. Tertiary: bg-yellow-500 text-white.
components_blueprint.KPIBadge: Inline flex, items-center, gap-2, bg-white rounded-full px-3 py-1 border border-slate-200. Left: Colored 8px circle (bullet). Middle: Label (text-xs text-slate-500). Right: Value (text-sm font-bold text-slate-900).
components_blueprint.SubTabs: Pill-style tabs. Container: inline-flex gap-1 bg-slate-100 p-1 rounded-full. Tab item: rounded-full px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-slate-600. Active tab: bg-white text-violet-700 shadow-sm.
components_blueprint.DataTable: Clean HTML table structure or shadcn Table. Thead: uppercase tiny labels, text-left. Tbody: generous py-4 padding. Highlighted client/name: text-violet-700 font-medium. Actions: right-aligned flex gap-2, using icon-only buttons (ghost, text-slate-400 hover:text-violet-600), no solid background.
components_blueprint.StatusPill: Tiny indicator for status (Ativo, Bloqueado). rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase. Ativo: bg-green-100 text-green-700. Bloqueado: bg-red-100 text-red-700.
components_blueprint.FullScreenModal: (For IA Center). Fixed inset-0 bg-slate-900/20 backdrop-blur-sm. Content: bg-white m-4 rounded-2xl flex flex-col overflow-hidden shadow-2xl. Internal sidebar or top tabs for 9 sub-sections.

refactoring_strategy.step_1: Implement global layout shell in App.js using the new AppShell structure (Sidebar + flex-1 content + TopBar).
refactoring_strategy.step_2: Consolidate UI tokens in src/ui.js. Export pre-styled components (e.g., Card, PillButton, KPIBadge) mapping to the design_tokens.
refactoring_strategy.step_3: Override shadcn-ui defaults directly in components/ui to apply the 'pill' aesthetic globally without touching every panel file.
refactoring_strategy.step_4: Incrementally convert legacy panels (e.g., LousaAdminPanel.js, CadastroPanel.js). Replace inline styles with the new ui.js components or Tailwind cascade classes.
refactoring_strategy.step_5: Enforce data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, nav items, tabs) for testability.

shadcn_utilization.Button: Modify default radius: replace 'rounded-md' with 'rounded-full'. Setup color variants (violet, red, yellow).
shadcn_utilization.Badge: Use for StatusPill. Set default to rounded-full, text-[10px], uppercase.
shadcn_utilization.Table: Utilize for lists. Customize TableHead with the 'table_header' typography token. Remove generic borders, keep rows clean.
shadcn_utilization.Tabs: Modify TabsList to use bg-slate-100, rounded-full, p-1. Modify TabsTrigger for rounded-full, active state bg-white, text-violet-700, shadow-sm.
